oracle: Unmodified original weighted *_impl functions and IQ4 reference entry points independently compiled into weighted_oracle.dll outside the Rust product.
qualifications: Unweighted IQ4_NL blocks with absolute maximum below GROUP_MAX_EPS are excluded from exact-byte comparison: the original reference routine packs an uninitialized L scratch array. Rust canonicalizes those undefined payload bytes to zero and keeps the original zero scale. Refined weighted IQ4_NL and IQ4_XS initialize levels and are compared including all-zero blocks.

Importance weights are explicit, finite and nonnegative. Unit, varying, sparse, random and all-zero weight rows are covered. Legacy variance is computed over the complete row, including multiblock cases.
